title: Faden! releases a new song titled "End of the night"
htmlContent:
Arizona-based rapper and singer Faden! gets his inspiration from J Cole and Jid. His style is different, more upbeat, and melodic. His rap style always tells a story.

"End of the Night," like all his other songs, tells a unique story, it is upbeat boom-bap kinda music, and it takes you out of your seat dancing to the beats.

Faden! is a unique rapper, and this particular song deserves every accolade. His extraordinary style and one-of-a-kind control of his rendition give " End of the night" a beautiful reprieve. Hearing much about Faden, we had to bring this excellent piece to our page.

Stream "End of the Night " on Spotify
